notes.title: The Celebration Update Has Gone Live!
notes.content:
Very excited to share our latest update ahead of our upcoming four month anniversary.  This is a moderately sized patch mostly focused on streamlining the opening half hour or so of the game, plus a few new & improved CG's, dialogue changes, and other goodies, the full list of which you can read below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699087/77490a18e793b8543d077d85075d184263df99fd.png[/img]

[b]Patch Notes
[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new CG's to Drumpf's storyline, replacing several that I was unhappy with in the initial release.
[*] Streamlined opening half hour or so of the game, cut back on extraneous text, and added a few Easter eggs.
[*] Several small changes made to Drumpf storylines ending, with some new dialogue added, and outdated text replaced.
[*] Improved background art for Jersey International Airport.
[*] Laid groundwork for a potential gallery feature, if that's something folks are interested in for the future.
[*] Fixed several small bugs in Macron Storyline.
[/list]
